doc.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Writing for Randy Weston after the stroke; friends
summary: She still writes for Randy, who she thinks pulled her out of the stroke; her real friends are fellow arrangers like Frank.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: But continuing on with the girl groups in New York – what came after? Did you do some more stuff with Randy?

I’ve been writing for Randy. I’m still writing for Randy. I wrote for him up until I had the stroke. After I had the stroke and got over a little bit, I’m writing for him again. I think he pulled me out of it – helped anyway. I thank him very much for sticking with me, because nobody else did.
My doctor said you find out who your friends really are.
Oh yeah. My friends really are Frank and all of those. They’re arrangers too. I can’t take nothing away from them. They’ll be my friends.
